title: Local AI Assistant
tagline: A privacy-first desktop AI interface running quantized open-source models completely offline.
description: An intelligent AI coding assistant that operates reliably during travel or network outages without sending proprietary code snippets over public web networks.

screenshots.title: Token Streaming Dashboard
screenshots.caption: Real-time streaming text generation from quantized LLaMA model

screenshots.title: Local Process Monitor
screenshots.caption: RAM usage holding steadily at ~4.7GB during continuous inference

architecture: React 18 Dashboard -> FastAPI SSE Proxy -> Ollama GGUF Engine -> Memory Buffer -> Streaming Response
database: SQLite local database storing encrypted user conversation histories, parameter configs, and custom system prompts.
folderStructure:
local-ai-assistant/
├── backend/
│   ├── app/main.py (FastAPI SSE router)
│   ├── app/ollama.py (Local process IPC client)
│   └── app/database.py (SQLite Session store)
├── frontend/
│   └── src/components/ChatStream.tsx
└── README.md
challenges: Handling initial model loading latency into system RAM without freezing the UI thread.
lessons: Memory bandwidth is the primary bottleneck for CPU-bound LLM inference, not compute capacity.
futureImprovements: Implement local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using SQLite VSS.
